description: Generate a per-agent secret (das_...) that marks this agent's API requests as a verified agent, which raises its API rate limits. Set it as DOMINUSNODE_AGENT_SECRET for this MCP server (sent as X-DominusNode-Agent-Secret). It does not bypass brute-force protections. Max 5 active secrets per account; the oldest is revoked. Requires authentication. Shown only once.

label.description: Human-readable label for the agent secret

name: dominusnode_create_agent_secret
